example: Example run with fictional figures: Northbrook Trading, the September 2026 close. The figures match the worked examples on the step-by-step page.

messages.text: Can you do our September accruals and deferrals?
Yes. Before I read anything, I need nine answers. I ask them all at once, so the run does not stop again for each one. The last two are optional.
list: Do you want me to use MosoFin, or will you upload the data?
Which period? Please give the exact start and end dates.
Which categories are in scope: compensation, interest, utilities and services, revenue, deferred revenue, professional fees or tax?
What supports each category? I need the facts that the books cannot show, such as the bonus estimate, loan terms, contract periods and fee letters.
Do accruals reverse on day one of the next month, or does the next bill post against the accrual?
Do you keep the books on the accrual basis or the cash basis?
Optional: which materiality threshold do you use? I never choose one for you.
Optional: which reporting framework and which tax country apply?

messages.text: Use MosoFin. Northbrook Trading, 1 to 30 September. Bonus, interest, utilities, audit fees and deferred revenue. Our managing director estimates the 2026 bonus at $240,000. Payroll tax is 8%. The auditor says 75% of the $12,000 audit is done. Accruals reverse on day one. Accrual basis. Materiality is $500. US GAAP and US tax.

messages.label: Found your workspace and company file

messages.text: I found one workspace, **Northbrook Trading**, with one company file of the same name. Is that the right one?

messages.label: Checked the tools, the profile and the chart
rows: Accrued expenses, Accrued liabilities – other, Deferred revenue
messages.summary: The agent can read your books. It cannot change them.

messages.text: Here is my plan for **Northbrook Trading, 1 to 30 September**, on the accrual basis. Your books are in US dollars with a calendar year, so September is month 9 of the bonus year. In scope are the **bonus**, **interest** on the term loan, **utilities**, **audit fees** and **deferred revenue**. Materiality is **$500**.
messages.after: Electricity and audit fees reverse on 1 October. The bonus, its payroll tax and the interest build up month by month, so they do not reverse. Deferred items go to your **Deferred revenue** account. For accruals, your chart has two accounts: **Accrued expenses** and **Accrued liabilities – other**. Which one do I use? And shall I start?

messages.text: Use Accrued expenses. Yes, go ahead.

messages.label: Read the books in one batch
rows: No reversal of the August accrual
messages.summary: 7 reads in one batch. Nothing in your books changed.

messages.text: I found five accruals for September. Each one has a basis that you or the books gave me:

card.title: September accruals
rows: + Employer payroll tax on the bonus, 8%
+ Interest on the $300,000 loan, 15 days at 6.5%

messages.after: For interest, I used the loan's own day count, actual/365. Actual/360 gives $812.50. Electricity and audit fees reverse on 1 October, a total of **$11,100**.

messages.text: The electricity accrual holds too much. Last month's estimate of **$2,040** did not reverse on 1 September:
messages.after: The real August bill of $2,170 went straight to Utilities expense on 9 September. Without the correction, September carries **$4,270** of electricity. With it, September carries $2,230.

messages.text: Two customers paid in advance. Pinnacle Clinics paid **$36,000** on 1 September, and all of it went to Revenue. I move the unearned part to Deferred revenue. I do not enter the receipt again.
messages.after: I also release $2,000 of Lakeside's payment for September. Together, the two contracts reduce September revenue by **$31,000**. Pinnacle's receipt has no sales tax.

messages.text: Three items stay out of my entries:

card.title: Not in this run
head: Item
Amount
Where it goes
rows: Small items list, with the total

messages.after: Water is $180 and the courier is $260. They get no entry, but the list keeps their total for your auditor.

messages.text: I propose these entries. Each one points to its evidence:

card.title: Proposed entries
head: Entry
Amount
Evidence
rows: Accrue payroll tax on the bonus
Accrue interest on the term loan
Move Pinnacle's unearned part to Deferred revenue
Reverse electricity and audit fees on 1 Oct

messages.after: After the correction, the net September expense is **$31,461.37**. Closing accrued liabilities are **$206,301.37**. I do not post these entries. A person on your team posts them. Do you want the workpaper as an Excel file?

messages.text: Done. **Accruals_Deferrals_2026-09.xlsx** has eight sheets, from the summary to the coverage sheet. The coverage sheet shows what came from your books and what came from you.
messages.after: Do you want me to save your settings for next month?

messages.text: Done. I saved your choices for Northbrook Trading: the categories, the threshold, the reversal policy, your accounts and the basis for each item. I did not save your connection or tool settings. I check those again at each run.
